work_package.hypothesis: replace separate scalar QK/softmax/serial PV with the already-vendored FlashInfer tensor-core GQA online attention and deterministic split-state merge
work_package.numerical_boundary: research-only changed reduction/probability-rounding class, not bit-exact to scalar. First shadow real API calls, compare component output and repeated execution, restore baseline output. No accuracy or production selection from coherent text.
work_package.ownership: research linker-wrapped binary only, old artifacts unchanged. Reuse internal FP32 scratch as temporary partition output/LSE only after proving bound. No KV/state/layout or weights modification; scratch probabilities are no longer an observable in this internal runner experiment, so it is not a public gqa API replacement.
work_package.bounds: FlashInfer chunk size >=256; tmp <=ceil(S/256)*(24*256*2+24*4) bytes <24*S*4 bytes for S>=512. Only shape24/4/256 and scale1/16 admitted. Short S stays baseline.
work_package.protocol: same pinned real token-ID prompt prefix at 1089/8192/40000, 32 generated tokens, one serialized API request at each length. Native baseline -> separate stock-vLLM eager diagnostic -> research shadow -> same native API with wrapper. Fresh preflight for each process. Output/usage/DONE and actual wrapper counts required.
work_package.composition_limit: one tensor-core implementation, at most one correctness/ownership repair. No tile scan. Immediate API return after safe shadow check; negative or unsafe closes. Maximum 30 minutes device time for native prototype including shadow; external startup separately bounded 20 minutes.
work_package.qualification: one-pass engineering direction only; exact installed main, public capability, full-state/logit qualification and release excluded

caveats: Global load requests do not establish DRAM traffic; prior L2-absorption conclusions were not hardware-counter measurements.
Prior 120024-warps attribution confuses block count with warp count; each 256-thread block contains 8 warps.
Pure-read calibration is not a proof of universal architecture ceiling.
Independent split kernel tuning does not test fused Tensor Core attention.
source_audit.reference: vLLM FlashInfer use_tensor_cores=True; FA2 packs six GQA heads into CTA Q tile16, splits KV across CTAs, and uses deterministic MergeStates. Triton unified attention similarly uses tl.dot, online softmax, per-segment partials, reduce_segments. FLA/Mamba recurrent state remains fixed size per token.
